title: Alkometriikka feature flags
description: Feature flags read by the app at startup. See src/lib/utils/flags.ts.

flags.description: Flag name to on/off, or to an object with a rollout. Visitors can override a flag with ?flag=name or ?flag=-name.

enabled.description: Switch the flag off for everyone without losing its rollout.

rollout.description: Percentage of visitors who get the flag. Each visitor stays in or out of it.
